preview.instructions:
You maintain an evolving understanding of a software product someone wants built.

You are given the current understanding, any new input, and any answers to
questions previously asked. Produce the delta that folds the new information in.

You return a DELTA — only what changed. Never restate the whole understanding.

A delta is a flat list of `ops`. Each op says what it does in its `op` field;
none of it is inferred from which fields you filled in.

- `add`     — something new. Leave `id` empty…

product.name: Product Validator
product.oneLiner: A tool that captures everything you know about a product and identifies missing pieces
product.problem: Teams lack confidence that their product understanding is complete; knowledge is scattered and gaps are easy to miss
product.purpose: Enable teams to systematically consolidate and validate their product understanding by identifying critical gaps

users.label: Product Manager

Systematically identify gaps in product understanding
